passages.text: In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD was angry with me.
The LORD turned His anger away from me.
The LORD comforted me.
I will praise the LORD on that day.
passages.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אוֹדְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑י יָשֹׁ֥ב אַפְּךָ֖ וּֽתְנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
passages.sermon:
God saves me.
I trust God.
I do not fear.
The LORD GOD gives me strength.
The LORD GOD is my song.
The LORD GOD has saved me.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְלֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי־ עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation, and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
passages.sermon:
God is the source of salvation.
You will draw water with joy from the springs of salvation.
On that day, you will speak.
You will say, “Give praise to the LORD.
Call on His name.
Make His works known among the peoples.
Declare that His name is exalted.”
passages.original: וּשְׁאַבְתֶּם־ מַ֖יִם בְּשָׂשׂ֑וֹן מִמַּעַיְנֵ֖י הַיְשׁוּעָֽה׃ וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא הוֹד֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִשְׁמ֔וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָֽעַמִּ֖ים עֲלִֽילֹתָ֑יו הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י נִשְׂגָּ֖ב שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has done glorious things.
Sing to the LORD.
Tell everyone about His great works.
Let all the earth know what He has done.
passages.original: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה מְיֻדַּעַת זֹ֖את בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The Holy One of Israel is great.
He lives among you.
You live in Zion.
Cry out with joy.
Sing with gladness.
passages.original: צַהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
